title: gilia achilleifolia subsp. multicaulis

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which have been attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
